_readme: Draft Wansford walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Back to the Haycock

layers.essential_history: [[c:Back where you started. Wansford in England, as the legend says.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The Nene Valley Railway, a heritage line, has its headquarters at Wansford station, east of the village.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The coach is ready to leave. Say who took the strongbox.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:That's the end of the walk. Well done, detective!]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Who took the strongbox?]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Look through your evidence notebook, then make your accusation.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who took it, why, and where is it now?]]

fields.label: Why?
options: To share the money with a highwayman friend
To keep it safe from Barnaby
fields.answer: To share the money with a highwayman friend

fields.label: Where is it now?
options: Lowered on a rope under the Old Bridge
fields.answer: Lowered on a rope under the Old Bridge

hints: [[c:Whose lantern was found by the bridge?]]
[[c:Who asked how deep the water was?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It was Ned Turpin, the coach guard. He wheeled the box to the middle of the bridge and lowered it on a rope to collect later with a highwayman friend. The box is pulled up, the coach leaves on time, and Barnaby's haycock story becomes the most famous thing about Wansford.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:You can solve this from your notebook alone.]]
